note: Ground-floor repair workshop of the B61 half-timbered brick repair café (same timber-and-brick style as the exterior): sage-green plaster between dark oak posts and beams, grey slate flagstones, daylight from the street windows plus a pendant work lamp. LANDMARK: the big pegboard tool wall with the giant cast-iron gear wheel (the gear echoes the shop sign outside). The glazed front door at the far left is the way back out to the square; the open doorway at the far right leads on into the café. Adjectives have no gender (divider null). Zoom: the stone sink corner at the back right (z1).
